textNodes.text: When a rooftop HVAC unit won't start, Diagnostiq finds what to check in its service manual. When an AI request misses the prompt cache, cachefault shows which field changed.
Avvi helps small businesses and managed service providers (MSPs) handle everyday IT tasks. Staff describe what they need in plain English, and the assistant prepares changes for a person to approve.
I built tools that helped faculty find academic papers and analyze published research.
I fine-tuned BERT for multiclass classification of streaming stock market news. I also built a tool to extract data from tender documents.
I rebuilt the backend for a recruiting platform that extracts candidate information from résumés.
